request: Slice C of the system-spec-delta epic (C2-2): make `/archive` verify the declared `## System delta` against the landed diff before applying anything. Replace Step 5's bare `contribute.syncBack` re-stamp with verify-then-apply through one entry point (D1) in `.claude/skills/workspace/delta.mjs` — `verifyDelta` confirms each parsed row against the landed diff scoped to the governed surface, `applyDelta` applies only confirmed rows (append anchor, re-run materialize, stampElement, write the shard via slice B's `writeDiagramShard`), and `verifyAndApplyDelta` composes them. Unconfirmed rows come back in `drift` with nothing written; governed paths no row claims and no element anchors come back in `unclaimed` with nothing written. Every return distinguishes `inputEmpty` from a no-match result. Step 5.5 invokes `/system-reconcile` report-only so the corpus is byte-identical between Step 5 completing and the workflow ending. Whole path is inert when `memory.architecture_map.enabled` is false or absent.
